findings.title: Raw campaign CLI fallback omits required Step4 admission checks
findings.evidence: Latest LAUNCH_ORDER ramp.fallback_zero_build and ROOT_ITEMS R-B6 recommend campaign_c2v005 CLI if the successor is not reviewed. CLI main calls run_campaign directly. Before subprocess.Popen, run_campaign validates supplied driver/monitor/spec hashes and resource settings, but never reads a sealed V007 report, STEP4 admission, PRELAUNCH record, r5 allowlist, or per-point/sensitivity gates. The ordinary root monitor does not add those checks. Orchestrator.run gates_ok and make_plan prelaunch_check are separate caller checks bypassed by direct CLI.
findings.impact: Manual prior planning or matching a driver hash does not bind current sealed/admission bytes at process creation. The fallback is not equivalent to the proposed reviewed STEP4 guard.
findings.resolution: Remove/disable this fallback for Step4, or require a separately reviewed pre-process admission wrapper with equivalent byte-bound checks. No launch helper was executed here.
findings.scope: A blocker to endorsing the recommended fallback, not proof that any unauthorized process ran. Candidate remains staged/unfrozen.
